rv.q: If I Made You a Mixtape wants us to join the party, it needs to do more than recreate it.
I A Mixtape is innovative, daring, and compelling.
This is a show that invites you to the party as a guest, not simply an audience member.
Despite the minor drawbacks, the show is an experimental triumph.

cn.t: This nostalgic 90s-fueled dance piece divides critics, with some embracing its joyful energy and movement-driven storytelling, while others find the execution falls short of its promising concept.
